seams.contract: A versioned, declarative Roots CI identity/cache-policy input consumed by existing workflows; it may constrain names, read-only cache keys, and permissions but cannot select runners, execute code, or grant credentials.
seams.dependency_direction: CI metadata may consume immutable Roots identity data; no src runtime library, wallet, node, or GUI target may depend on CI metadata.
migration_stages: add an offline-validated data input alongside existing workflow values
compare generated workflow fragments and CI permission/cache fixtures
remove duplicated literal Roots identity only after reviewer approval
seams.policy_consensus_protection: Not applicable to block validity: this seam is CI metadata and cannot link into src.
seams.expected_conflict_reduction: Targets the three recorded 29.4 manual CI paths; no reduction beyond that one-migration observation is claimed.
seams.rollback: Retain current literals and delete the unused data input; no candidate runtime state changes.
seams.dependencies_risks: Requires workflow-security review; risk is permission or cache-boundary regression.
seams.leave_inline_alternative: Keep reviewed literals inline if one data input cannot cover all three paths without obscuring Core workflow topology.

seams.contract: No new module is approved. P2P/node and local-policy declarations remain at their owners until characterization proves a narrow, non-consensus policy boundary without absorbing P2P ownership.
seams.ownership: Roots P2P/node maintainers and local relay/mining-policy maintainers
seams.dependency_direction: Any future policy-only interface may depend on util/common and policy, never consensus, validation, or P2P/node ownership; consensus and block acceptance must not depend on it.
migration_stages: characterize block acceptance against local-policy changes
measure header dependency and resource behavior
seek a separate reviewed implementation decision
characterization_tests: block containing locally rejected transaction remains acceptable
seams.policy_consensus_protection: RDTS/BIP110 consensus enforcement remains absent. Local relay, mempool, and template policy must not alter block validity, script rules, serialization, or consensus parameters.
seams.expected_conflict_reduction: The P2P and policy owners each have one actual manual path; txrequest is a separately absorbed P2P path. Those independent measurements identify review pressure, not a safe extraction, so conflict reduction is intentionally unclaimed.
performance_resource_gates: no new allocation or lock-order regression
preserve mempool limits and template behavior
seams.rollback: No migration is authorized; retain current declarations.
seams.dependencies_risks: Requires policy/consensus review; risk is policy-to-consensus leakage and changed mempool resource behavior.
seams.leave_inline_alternative: Approved decision: keep src/node/miner.h with P2P/node and src/txmempool.h with policy until separate ownership contracts are characterized.

seams.contract: An immutable compile-time Roots presentation descriptor for application name, icon/resource names, and deterministic packaging inputs; no runtime extension or behavior dispatch.
seams.dependency_direction: Qt presentation code consumes the descriptor and Qt resources; node, wallet, kernel, consensus, and util libraries never depend on it.
migration_stages: characterize startup title, help, resource, package, and translation outputs
introduce descriptor adjacent to Qt resources
migrate one presentation consumer at a time
regenerate only approved derived outputs and compare packaging fixtures
characterization_tests: Qt startup/title and resource lookup tests
built help/config identity check where applicable
seams.policy_consensus_protection: Presentation data is Qt-only and may not be referenced from policy, validation, serialization, script, or consensus targets.
seams.expected_conflict_reduction: Addresses distinct 106-path Knots-origin and 13-path Roots continuation presentation surfaces after manual hotspots; no manual-conflict count is claimed.
performance_resource_gates: resource manifest remains bounded and deterministic
seams.rollback: Keep old resource literals and remove the descriptor before release packaging; no wallet or node data migration exists.
seams.dependencies_risks: Requires Qt, translation, and packaging review; risk is generated-asset or translation drift.
seams.leave_inline_alternative: Keep individual Qt literals inline if the descriptor becomes a universal fork abstraction or crosses the Qt boundary.
